title: EventBus callback data deep-copy isolation contract

contract.deep_copy_per_delivery: Each callback receives an isolated deep copy of emitted event data
contract.callback_local_mutation: A callback can mutate its received payload without affecting other callbacks
contract.nested_data_isolation: Nested mutable structures remain isolated between callback deliveries
contract.list_data_isolation: Mutable list structures remain isolated between callback deliveries
contract.source_payload_isolation: Callback mutations do not modify the original emitter payload
contract.callback_independence: A callback mutation does not leak into subsequent callback deliveries
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful while callbacks mutate their local payload
contract.registry_stability: Payload mutation does not modify the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus event delivery continues to require the events permission
